blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The University of the Philippines (UP) and the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) have partnered to strengthen flood management in Metro Manila through research, technical assistance and science-based planning. The two institutions signed a memorandum of understanding on Wednesday, Oct. 21, establishing a framework for cooperation in research, knowledge-sharing, capacity-building and the development of practical tools for flood mitigation. The partnership supports the government’s Oplan Kontra Baha initiative, which includes plans to build 39 detention basins under the Metro Manila Sponge City Project.
